strings: r_c0 considers m_c's leg. It might be possible to re-break it, but it will likely always heal twisted after this. Instead, {PRONOUN/r_c0/subject} {VERB/r_c0/leave/leaves} it as it's healing well.
The damage to m_c's leg was simply too great. While it has managed to heal, r_c0 tells m_c that it will always be twisted at an odd angle.
{PRONOUN/m_c/poss/CAP} broken bone has healed twisted, but m_c is just so glad to be free of the boredom of recovery.
Twisted is better than gone is what m_c tells {PRONOUN/m_c/self}. Broken legs can be deadly. m_c is lucky to still be alive.
